payload.feature:
Contributing goes through Brokkr, mandatory, and the contributing guide becomes a sixty-second read. The operator ruled in chat on 2026-09-02: "I want contributing to be via brokkr, mandatory, and that to be in the contributing guidelines. So if we have which strategy / recipe to run, it will essentially be a 60s read - that should be our goal."

Enact:

1. CONTRIBUTING.md is rewritten as a sixty-second read: one screen, under 120 lines. Install brokkr (one command, the release channels the README already lists), fork and clone, pick the recipe for the shape of your change from ONE table (recipe, when to use it, what it seats, roughly what it costs), light it with one command (brokkr run --recipe <name> --feature "<what you want>"), let the machine verify, review and ship, then open the pull request citing the run. The current 610-line handbook (the nine checks with their exact commands, the coverage practicalities and refusal shapes, the signing walkthrough, the decision culture, the frozen surfaces) moves whole into docs/guides/contributing-by-hand.md, linked from the short guide in one sentence for the curious; the machine's verify seat runs those checks, a contributor does not need to. Say plainly, in one line, what happens at merge today: seat commits are unsigned, main requires signatures, the operator squash-merges and that merge is the signed commit.

2. The recipe table is data, not typing. Every recipe's bundle.json gains a one-line "description" (today crucible, ember, fast, night-shift, node, panel-review, preflight, sdd, sdd-paranoid, wager-harness and wager-harness-dsh have none), brokkr recipes list keeps printing the library, and a test compares the guide's table with the recipe library so the two cannot drift.

3. Mandatory has teeth, because a determinable ruling compiles (Decisions as Code). Write docs/decisions/<next free number>-contributing-through-brokkr.md, Status: accepted (operator ruled in chat, 2026-09-02), and index it in docs/decisions/README.md. The ruling: every pull request to main is delivered by a Brokkr run and names it. The enforcement, in its minimal deterministic form: a pull request template (.github/pull_request_template.md) carrying a "Brokkr-Run:" line, and a CI job named "delivered by brokkr" that (a) requires the PR body to carry Brokkr-Run: <run id> in the run-id grammar, and (b) verifies that the run vouches for this PR's head commit by evidence the contributor can publish without the operator's journal: the run's anchor (brokkr anchor writes refs/forge/<run> locally today) pushed to the PR's branch namespace, or an exported journal (brokkr export) committed under the PR or attached, whichever the fire finds smallest and verifiable offline with brokkr verify-run; the job then checks that the vouched head equals the PR head. If the anchor needs to carry the shipped tree's commit id to make that check possible, add it. No agent judgment anywhere in the job; it is a platform check. An escape hatch exists and is explicit: the label by-hand, set by the operator only, skips the job and the skip is visible in the check's own output. Note in the decision that the operator must add the job to main's required checks after this lands (branch protection is the operator's, not the machine's).

4. The README's contributing section and its table row point at the short guide; the release and bootstrap paths are untouched.

This pull request must itself obey the ruling: the shipper writes the Brokkr-Run: line for this run into the PR body and publishes whatever evidence the new job demands, so the job passes on its own introduction.

Verification: cargo fmt --check, clippy, the full test suite, and the exact coverage gate at 100% lines, branches and functions. Windows CI: any path inside an sh -c script uses forward slashes and quotes, and every read is read -r.

result.notes: Implemented mandatory Brokkr-delivered pull requests, the 60-second data-checked contributing guide, and offline anchor verification in CI. Format, clippy, full workspace tests, and exact 100% line/branch/function coverage pass; committed as 79661af.

Verifier seat, tree clean at 79661af. Step 1: `cargo test --workspace` — every test binary reported `0 failed`; 899 passed across 52 result lines (brokkr-cli 222 unit + 154 integration incl. machine_proof 56, contributing 2, recipes 10; brokkr-core 47 unit + differential 3 + fold 7 + policy_lint 2; brokkr-protocol 79 + 1 doctest; brokkr-runtime 220 unit + 46 integration; brokkr-store 43 + 6; brokkr-view 58; brokkr-bridge 13). Step 2: `cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self` exited 0 and printed the compiled manifest (digest b5e40fd0…, engine 0.7.0, phases intake/implement/verify/review/ship/done/stop, seats implement/intake/review/ship/verify). No code changed, nothing committed.

Reviewer seat, head d65702d (one fix commit on top of 79661af). Correctness: the run-id grammar matches the engine's slug (take(32) + '-' + 8 uuid hex); the CI job's jq paths match the export (type, payload.from/result, seq, event_hash) and verify-run's summary (chain, state.run_id, state.status=completed); vouched_head reads reviewed_heads from the review decision and the fast/self ship rules route drift_detected back to review, so a shipped run's reviewed head is the shipped head; the by-hand handbook moved whole (only link relativisation); the recipe-table test is data-driven and fails on any recipe missing description/cost. Security: PR body is env-only and the run id is regex-validated before use in refspec/paths; the verifier builds from base.sha not the PR; token is read-only; jq args are passed as --arg. FIXED (committed): CONTRIBUTING step 1 told contributors to `cargo binstall brokkr-cli`, which packaging/README records as waiting on a crates.io publication, so the sixty-second path failed at its first command; it now cites the README's release archive and `cargo install --path crates/brokkr-cli`. FIXED (committed): decision 0031 now states that the by-hand label is read from the pull_request event (re-runs replay it; close/reopen or push after labelling) and that this PR's own evidence must be re-anchored with the branch binary (`cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- anchor --run <id>`) because the completing engine predates the v2 anchor. RESIDUAL low (correctness/usability, not security): ci.yml's pull_request trigger has no `labeled`/`unlabeled` types, so applying by-hand does not by itself re-evaluate the check; documented workaround is close/reopen. Proper fix is a dedicated workflow file for the job with types including labeled/unlabeled, left to the operator since it changes what triggers CI. RESIDUAL info (security, ruled): the journal chain and anchor are unsigned, so a deliberate contributor can fabricate a completed+shipped journal vouching any head; decision 0031 ruling 3 states this is tamper-evidence not identity proof, and the operator's review and squash-merge remain the authority. INFO: the job also does not cross-check the anchor's repo_head against the embedded journal's reviewed_heads (both are contributor-produced, so the gain is small). Shipper: put `Brokkr-Run: contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb` in the PR body, and after the run completes the operator re-anchors with the branch binary and pushes refs/forge/<id>:refs/heads/brokkr-runs/<id>; the head must be the run's final commit (no amend-signing before the PR).

Shipper prepare step. Tree clean at d65702d, which equals the review's reviewed head; no commits made. Ledger written to .forge/ledger/contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb.md (gitignored, not committed). Delivered: CONTRIBUTING.md is an 80-line sixty-second read with a data-checked recipe table (test compares it to the recipe library), the 610-line handbook moved whole to docs/guides/contributing-by-hand.md, every recipe bundle has a description, decision 0031 (accepted) plus PR template and the deterministic CI job 'delivered by brokkr' with the visible by-hand escape hatch, v2 anchor carrying repo_head, README points at the short guide. Evidence: verify seat passed 899/0 at 79661af with fmt/clippy/100% coverage reported by implement; the review fix d65702d is docs-only and on this HEAD fmt is clean and the contributing (2) and recipes (10) tests pass. Residual (low): ci.yml lacks labeled/unlabeled trigger types so by-hand needs a close/reopen or push to take effect. Operator next: review the two commits; after the run concludes, re-anchor with the branch binary (cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- anchor --run contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb), push the branch and refs/forge/<run>:refs/heads/brokkr-runs/<run> to origin, open the PR with the body drafted in the ledger carrying 'Brokkr-Run: contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb', keep the head at d65702d (no amend-sign or rebase), squash-merge once 'delivered by brokkr' is green, then add that job to main's required checks.

Shipper close-out. git status --porcelain is empty and HEAD is d65702da4fb17053349f90e9771678bab76163a8, identical to the HEAD the ledger recorded; nothing moved since the prepare step and no commits were made in this phase. Shipped on branch slice-contributing-through-brokkr as two commits, 79661af (the feature) and d65702d (the review's docs-only fix): CONTRIBUTING.md as an 80-line sixty-second read with a recipe table checked against the recipe library by test; the 610-line handbook moved whole to docs/guides/contributing-by-hand.md; a description on every recipe bundle; decision 0031 (accepted, indexed) with the PR template and the deterministic 'delivered by brokkr' CI job plus the visible by-hand escape hatch; v2 anchor carrying repo_head; README pointing at the short guide. Evidence: verify passed 899/0 at 79661af with fmt, clippy and 100% coverage; at d65702d fmt is clean and the contributing and recipes tests pass. Residual (low): ci.yml lacks labeled/unlabeled trigger types, so the by-hand label needs a close/reopen or a push to take effect. Ledger: .forge/ledger/contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb.md (gitignored, not committed). Operator next: review the two commits; after the run concludes, anchor with the branch binary (cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- anchor --run contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb) and confirm the anchor's repo_head is d65702da4fb17053349f90e9771678bab76163a8; push the branch and refs/forge/<run>:refs/heads/brokkr-runs/<run> to origin; open the PR with the body drafted in the ledger carrying 'Brokkr-Run: contributing-goes-through-brokkr-0fbcddeb'; keep the head exactly at d65702d (no amend-sign, no rebase, or the check fails by design); squash-merge once 'delivered by brokkr' is green, which becomes the signed commit on main; then add that job to main's required checks. Nothing was pushed, merged, or opened by this seat.
